Name: Nova Avatar, Ancient
Information:
**Nova Avatar**

Within the core of each burning star is a gateway to the Plane of Positive Energy, and from those gates sometimes flows embodiments of the plane itself, in the form of nova avatars. These are not necessarily natives to the Plane of Positive Energy, but rather are flickers of starlight that the planes grant animation and will. Nova avatars typically reside within stars themselves, defending them from threats, but when one disappears (such as through a supernova), its inhabitants may be thrown across the universe in a confused rage.

Information Sections.Text:

traits.name: Body of Illumination
traits.description: The elemental projects bright sunlight 60 feet in every direction, then dim light 60 feet beyond that. Creatures cannot benefit from being invisible within the elemental’s bright light, where they are made plainly visible. Similarly, creatures in the Ethereal Plane in this range are visible and treated as though they are in the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Positive Energy Fissure
traits.description: If a non-elemental creature regains hit points from a magical effect or magical item within 120 feet of the elemental, they regain twice as many hit points, but their maximum hit points are reduced by half the amount they would have healed before this adjustment. If an effect would simply restore them to maximum hit points, their maximum hit points are reduced by half of what they regain.

traits.name: Sunstricken Body
traits.description: When a creature hits the elemental with a melee attack from within 5 feet of it, they take 5 (1d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Neutron Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) radiant damage.

actions.name: Burden of a Star’s Heart (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
The elemental creates a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it chooses within 120 feet, which serves as a puncture in space leading to the Positive Energy Plane. The sphere shares the elemental’s Body of Illumination trait. Once when they create the sphere, then twice as a bonus action on each of its subsequent turns, the elemental can fire a beam of energy from it at a creature it can see within 120 feet of the sphere, who must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (3d20) radiant damage on a failure.

As an action on its turn, the elemental can move the sphere’s center to a new point within 60 feet of its current location, where it reappears. A creature who starts their turn within the sphere or enters it for the first time on their turn must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (5d10) radiant damage on a failure, and taking half as much damage on a success.

The elemental must concentrate on this effect as though it was a spell, and cannot roll to recharge it unless they stop concentrating.

actions.name: Fiery Teleport
actions.description: The elemental teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 80 feet, then makes a single Neutron Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The elemental makes one Neutron Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Positive Objection (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each non-elemental creature within 30 feet of the elemental that has temporary hit points has them reduced by 100 points, and the elemental regains hit points equal to the amount they lost.

legendary_actions.name: Solar Flash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The elemental’s body surges with light, causing each non-elemental creature within 30 feet of it to make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. Each creature that fails is blinded until the end of the elemental’s next turn, and gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.
